{"metadata":{"description":"Turn your local Obsidian vault into a RAG chat panel inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 100% local BM25 retrieval, clickable citations. 把本地 Obsidian 变成 DSH 的本地知识库对话面板。","id":"gh:1415116420","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-obsidian-board","slug":"2026heshao/dsh-obsidian-board","topics":["bm25","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","knowledge-base","local-first","notes","obsidian","rag","second-brain"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Turn your local Obsidian vault into a RAG chat panel inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 100% local BM25 "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"retrieval, clickable citations. 把本地 Obsidian 变成 DSH 的本地知识库对话面板。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-obsidian-board"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your local **Obsidian vault** into a **dedicated RAG chat"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" panel** inside the DSH GUI — a sidebar entry leading to a full three-pane page: note browser on the"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" left, retrieval-augmented chat in the middle, cited note source on the right. The desktop app and t"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"he Web GUI ship the same browser-rendered client, so the panel behaves identically in both. Indexing"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" and BM25 matching run **100% locally** (no embedding model, no vector database); the optional plann"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"er query rewrite and answer generation go through the model channel you already configured in DSH — "},{"id":"p4s7","text":"only your question, the recent conversation and the retrieved snippets are sent, never the vault its"},{"id":"p4s8","text":" your question, the recent conversation and the retrieved snippets are sent, never the vault itself."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Not an MCP integration, not an Obsidian plugin** — this is a dual-half DSH plugin (host + browse"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"r client). The UI is injected into the DSH main window as a `main` slot page (same mechanism as swit"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ching conversations); model calls reuse the host `ctx.llm`; the knowledge base points at your local "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"vault directory (Obsidian doesn't even need to be running)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 🔍 **Local-first retrieval** — BM25 with CJK bigram tokenization, title/path boosting, Obsidian tag"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" & alias awareness. No embedding model; indexing and BM25 matching make no network calls, and the va"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ult itself never leaves your machine. Answer generation (plus the optional planner query rewrite) us"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"es the DSH model channel you configured — question, recent conversation and retrieved snippets only."},{"id":"p8s5","text":"
- 🎯 **Finds what you actually wrote** — your own notes outrank collected third-party material (publ"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ic skill libraries are down-weighted), long identifiers such as `github_pat_…` are matched literally"},{"id":"p8s7","text":", and meaningful hidden folders (e.g. `.workbuddy/`) are indexed instead of silently skipped.
- 🛑 **"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"Stop that actually stops** — the stop button takes effect at any stage, including the retrieval/plan"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ning phase and the model's silent period before its first token. Stopped replies are shown as a neut"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ral "stopped" state, not a red error. Double-press Escape does the same thing from anywhere on the p"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"age.
- ⌨️ **A composer that behaves like the main chat** — the input card is rebuilt against the hos"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"t InputBar's geometry and interaction contract: send and stop share one primary button (the stop squ"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"are appears while a reply streams and the box is empty), Enter while a reply is still generating que"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ues the message instead of losing it (queued items list above the card, auto-send after the current "},{"id":"p8s15","text":"answer finishes, each individually removable, and an explicit stop hands the text back to the input "},{"id":"p8s16","text":"instead of dropping it), IME composition is respected so picking a candidate with Enter never sends "},{"id":"p8s17","text":"a half-typed message, the box auto-grows, and focus returns to the input after you send. The focus i"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ndicator is drawn on the rounded card, so no rectangular outline floats over it.

Everything else "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"sh/profiles/web` for `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`) in the commands above. The host-side history is in-memory and cleared on service restart. Model calls go t"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"hrough the host `ctx.llm`, so quotas, retries, and provider routing behave exactly like your main DS"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"host `ctx.llm`, so quotas, retries, and provider routing behave exactly like your main DSH sessions."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 特性"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- 🔍 **本地优先检索**——BM25 + 中文 bigram 切词、标题/路径加权、Obsidian 标签与别名感知。不用 embedding；索引与 BM25 召回不发任何网络请求，vault "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"整库不出本机——回答生成（以及可选的 planner 查询改写）走你在 DSH 配好的模型通道，只发送问题、最近对话与命中片段。
- 🎯 **找得到你真正写的东西**——自有笔记优先于收集来的第三方语"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"料（公开 skill 库降权）、`github_pat_…` 这类长标识符按字面精确匹配、有意义的隐藏目录（如 `.workbuddy/`）也会纳入索引而非被静默跳过。
- 🛑 **停止真的能停**—"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"—停止按钮在**任何阶段**都生效，包括检索/规划阶段、以及模型吐首字前的静默期；被停止的回复显示中性「已停止」状态，而不是红色报错。页面任意位置连按两次 Esc 同样能停。
- ⌨️ **输入框与主"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"对话页同构**——输入卡按宿主 InputBar 的几何与交互契约重做：发送与停止共用一个主按钮（生成中且输入框为空时变成停止方块）；生成中按 Enter 不再打断当前回答，而是把消息排进队列（队列条"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"目列在输入卡上方，本轮回答结束后自动发送，可单条移除；显式停止时会把待发的文本退回输入框，不静默吞掉）；输入法合成期按 Enter 只选词不发送，中文候选词不会把半截消息发出去；输入框自动增高，发送后"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"焦点回到输入框。聚焦态的高亮画在圆角卡片上，不会再浮出一个和卡片不贴合的直角蓝框。
